parsed.lessons_learned: MOON entry was at too high a price relative to initial — ended up with far fewer tokens than expected for the USDT spent, resulting in an underwater position. In future, calculate exact token quantity before entering at AMM prices since pool price may already be elevated. Sell signals include: promoter getting louder (GoldenWhale escalating $0.05 target), retail asking to exit (HappyTrader locking profits), and multiple cycles of price appreciation already baked in. False solidarity messaging is effective cover for selling into a pump.
